remarks: Beautifully Refreshed Home with an Open Layout and Indoor-Outdoor Living in Orange! Discover a home where modern updates, an inviting open-concept layout, and indoor-outdoor living come together. Freshly painted inside and out, this home offers a clean, refreshed feel with new flooring, updated fixtures, and ceiling fans throughout. The open-concept design creates a welcoming flow between living spaces, while two sliding glass doors invite natural light inside and provide easy access to the outdoors, making everyday living and entertaining a breeze.
